messages:
Nina: Heads-up: Meridian Labs (acct ML-309) flagged INV-2026-3300 for $8,642. They requested a 2-month plan and opened a dispute for an "automated batch" on 03/02. Filing here.

Sam: Got it. Do we have PO or updated billing contact? They sent PO-ML-12 and said billing@meridianlabs.io.

Leo: Audit ticket #4192 opened. Initial review shows one job id 4522 looks like a duplicated run. I can confirm after full log pull.

Nina: Customer proposes 50% now, 50% in 30 days. No suspension while on plan. Any objections?

Sam: Accept if they provide ACH mandate and sign payment plan + dispute waiver. Also add $50 processing fee.

collections-bot: Reminder: dunning email scheduled at 1815560000 if no signed plan or payment received.

Leo: Quick update: job 4522 is likely a retry from their scheduler. Tentative credit estimate $420 if confirmed. Will update in 24 hours.

Nina: Sent DocuSign and Stripe invoice to billing@meridianlabs.io. Marking AR: ML-309-2MP. Will monitor ledger and report when first payment posts.

Sam: If first payment posts, pause escalation. If payment fails, escalate to senior collector after 3 business days.

Nina: Noted. Keeping thread for records. Thanks.
